description: This file defines a utility class 'DateUtils' providing date-related helper methods, including week number calculations, date comparisons, and internal time utilities, for a book tracking application.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: A utility class for date calculations and comparisons within the book project.

classes.name: TimeUtils
classes.description: A nested static class providing current date/time utilities, primarily for internal use within DateUtils.

methods.name: getCurrentWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Returns the current week number of the year based on the current date.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks remaining in the year from the current week number.

methods.name: dateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the current year.

methods.name: isDateInFuture
methods.description: Determines if a given date is in the future relative to the current date.
